title: loom
tagline: From natural language to DeFi workflow automation with an agent marketplace.
description: loom is a natural-language DeFi automation marketplace where users and agents can turn plain language intents into reusable workflows. Users can create workflows such as Aave deposits, Uniswap DCA swaps, or Lido-style staking flows, publish them to a marketplace, and reuse workflows created by others. The project also supports ElizaOS agents and Gensyn AXL, allowing agents to browse workflows, create new ones, execute guarded Sepolia live-runs, and exchange workflow drafts peer-to-peer through AXL.
how_its_made: loom was built as a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with a React frontend, Hono backend, shared Zod schemas, DeFi template packages, Foundry contracts, and an ElizaOS plugin. The backend handles workflow creation, marketplace listings, publishing, and lifecycle APIs. Templates define Aave, Uniswap, and Lido mock flows with Sepolia metadata. The ElizaOS plugin lets agents browse the marketplace, create workflows through the API, and execute live-runs through guarded signer/reader adapters. For Gensyn AXL, we added workflow envelope drafts and a two-agent demo where one AXL node sends a workflow and another receives it, verifies it, and can publish it back into the marketplace.
auto_summary: A monorepo for creating, sharing, and executing natural-language DeFi workflows through a web app, API, agent plugin, and supporting contracts.
